Description: Baseline requirements, stakeholder validation, and change control.
Auth, RBAC, environment hardening, CI baseline.
Solution catalog, taxonomy integration, filtering and details.
User profile and organization lifecycle workflows.
LISA-based query understanding and recommendation flow.
Expert videos and legal content management.
Regression, UAT, go-live readiness, hypercare.
Conduct interviews across sponsor, moderators, end-users, and ops. AC: notes for all groups; >=20 actionable requirements; open questions with owners.
Approve SRS baseline and lock MVP scope. AC: SRS approved; MoSCoW agreed; scope-change workflow documented.
Define UAT scenarios for critical flows. AC: scenarios for auth, catalog, helpdesk, admin with pass/fail criteria.
Implement and verify register/login/refresh/logout reliability. AC: staging success; invalid tokens rejected; logout invalidates refresh path.
Ensure all protected endpoints enforce role/scoped permissions. AC: matrix verified; unauthorized blocked; own/others checks tested.
Add startup validation and env checklist. AC: missing vars fail startup with actionable errors; dev/prod checklists documented.
Establish CI build and smoke checks for frontend/backend. AC: builds run; API health and app load smoke checks pass.
Deliver reliable taxonomy tree API and UI binding. AC: hierarchical endpoint output and UI rendering without broken nodes.
Implement end-to-end search/filter for digital solutions. AC: taxonomy-filtered subsets correct; pagination and sort consistent.
Provide detail page with metadata, tags, links, related content. AC: complete payload rendered; optional fields handled gracefully.
Prevent destructive taxonomy updates when in use. AC: conflict response returned; UI shows clear blocked-operation state.
Allow users to view/edit own profile with validation. AC: allowed fields editable; invalid inputs return feedback.
Implement role-based organization CRUD with reference-safe deletes. AC: role checks enforced; forbidden blocked; conflicts return 409.
Process helpdesk prompts into structured filters or clarification. AC: valid prompts handled; failures return graceful fallback.
Map LISA filter terms to taxonomy IDs. AC: quality validated on representative prompts; unmatched terms handled safely.
Ensure helpdesk output is based on activated DB solutions only. AC: suggestions correspond to DB records; response includes source note.
Integrate widget with loading/error/empty states. AC: send and retry work; mobile and desktop remain usable.
Deliver role-based expert video CRUD with metadata consistency. AC: authorized actions work; errors are clear.
Manage terms/privacy/accessibility/imprint by role. AC: latest content editable/retrievable; changes persisted with metadata.
Record user acceptance for required policies. AC: timestamp + user association stored; duplicate handling follows policy.
Automate high-risk permission regression coverage. AC: matrix coverage in tests; authz failures block release.
Verify critical journeys in staging. AC: login/search/detail/helpdesk/admin smoke flows pass on release candidate.
Execute UAT with stakeholders and close critical defects. AC: completion report signed; no Sev-1/Sev-2 at go-live decision.
Complete release checklist and run initial hypercare. AC: rollback and checklist approved; monitoring ownership active.
